The earlier resume note said to keep the world and the pack; that ruling is superseded by measurement. Three candidate decisive steps were worked against the pack on disk and all three died on their own numbers. The reason is structural and is the finding: the call's arithmetic has exactly eight inputs (sites in scope, deliverable positions, sessions staffed a week, treatments a position delivers in a session, the area's 2026 treatments, a week, the growth factor, the cushion and rounding), seven of which are a filed column, a filed constant or an exact count, and the eighth is architecture 3's spent quantity. Any step that moves one of the seven moves the population, the outcome, the window, the unit or the comparison, which determinism-check section 1 requires filed: filed, it is rule application; unfiled, it is a fork. Area headroom runs plus 26.4 to plus 38.5 per cent at the six clear areas and minus 6.7 to minus 11.1 at the six short ones, so a verdict cell flips only on a move of 6.7 to 20.9 per cent of an area's own figure, and every parameter-free demand construction moves them 0.46 to 6.70 per cent: all twelve verdicts hold under the filed base, the mean of 52 weekly counts, the tail completed, trailing 13 and trailing 26 weeks and the four-year trend alike. Candidate 1 (the standing treatment panel instead of delivered throughput) moved 0 of 12 verdict cells and every correction walked one way, so a response on the filed base lands the whole call. Candidate 2 (a level rather than a multi-year mean, on the April 2025 panel step-down at six sites) failed rule 1 on the swap and its trend's prediction standard error is 45.6 and 45.8 slots at the only two cells it moves, against 23-slot capacity gaps, so the measurement model is twice the step's worth.
